teaser: A meeting room rearranged before anyone else arrives. A half-built app, abandoned three weeks in for a sharper idea. You are a 1, the number called The Leader, crossed with an ENTP, called The Debater. Neither pulls toward patience. The 1 reaches to be first; the Debater reaches to be right, or at least to find the crack in whatever everyone else already believes. Crossed, they make someone who starts fast, argues loudly, and sometimes finishes — the hard part was never starting.
